sentences.en: Extragalactic stars can only be observed with optic instruments.
sentences.zh: 只有借助光学仪器才能观测到星系外的恒星。

sentences.en: Love can't bloom over a fiber optic cable.
sentences.zh: 爱情无法通过光纤电缆滋生。

sentences.en: His study of optics led him to the invention of the magnifying glass.
sentences.zh: 他对光学的研究促使他发明了放大镜。
